name: Okitsune Nakadashi Ongaeshi ~Onee-san no Naka de Ippai Kimochi Yoku Natte ne~
original_name: おキツネ中出し恩返し ～お姉さんの中でいーっぱい気持ちよくなってね～
source:
Our hero is a college student who lives in a rural town.
One day he comes across a wounded fox, which he treats. Then a naked woman appears before him, claiming she is the fox and that she wants to return the favor.
That is the beginning of a life with the big breasted fox girl, who repays the favor by letting him ejaculate inside of her as much as he wants.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE037835.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名住在乡村小镇的大学生。
一天，他遇见一只受伤的狐狸并替它疗伤。随后，一名裸体女子出现在他面前，声称自己就是那只狐狸，想要报答他的恩情。
他与丰满狐女的共同生活由此开始；作为报恩，她允许他随心所欲地在自己体内射精。
